Review the reference production-hardened architecture and implementation contrast.

referenceMaterial.summary: Strict Safety Adopt low-latency collectors (ZGC or Shenandoah) designed for sub- millisecond pauses. Pre-size young generation buffers, eliminate boxing in tight loops, and allocate large long-lived read buffers off-heap via DirectByteBuffer or Netty ByteBuf. Invariant: "Distributed heartbeat deadlines must exceed maximum allowable STW GC pause thresholds by at least 3x; prefer concurrent low-latency collectors (ZGC) for stateful nodes."

3. Invariant Enforcement: Distributed heartbeat deadlines must exceed maximum allowable STW GC pause thresholds by at least 3x; prefer concurrent low-latency collectors (ZGC) for stateful nodes.

Outage Impact: Cascading lock convoys and memory saturation. Mitigation: Isolated failure domains keep P99 latency flat and protected.

stages.learnerPrompt: What catastrophic failure physics occur when capacity limits or downstream dependencies degrade under peak load?

referenceMaterial.summary: Failure physics analysis: Network Partition → Heartbeat Timeout → Dual Primaries → 💥 Split-Brain Drift.
failureModes: Cascading Failure: High object allocation rate creates massive generational churn; G1GC fails to keep pace with concurrent marking, degenerating into Full STW GC pauses lasting 8–15 seconds. Cluster coordinator marks node dead, revoking leases and triggering split-brain failover .
Breakdown Chain: Network Partition → Heartbeat Timeout → Dual Primaries → 💥 Split-Brain Drift
Shedding Failure: Without fast rejection at the boundary, queued dead work triggers multi-second GC pauses, CPU thrashing, and cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts.
